messages.subject: Caldervale — they've terminated
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We have a problem. Caldervale Underwriting sent us a letter on 17 October terminating the Polaris contract with immediate effect, claiming the platform hasn't met the availability SLA. It hasn't — our monitoring is clean. They still owe us the £90k Milestone 2 from a year ago, and there are two years left to run at £420k a year. This feels like buyer's remorse after they got bought.

Can you take this on?

Nadia

messages.subject: RE: Caldervale — they've terminated
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Yes, we'll act. On the face of it this looks like a wrongful termination and a strong claim — the unpaid milestone plus the balance of the term. Two things will matter: (1) the Schedule 4 measurement methodology (does it exclude maintenance and their own network?), and (2) whether they gave any contractual termination notice with a remedy period.

Tom Gallagher will run it day to day. Engagement letter to follow.

Sarah Whitfield
